topic: The Logic of Abstract Vector Spaces

sections.title: From Concrete to Abstract: The Intuition
lecture_lines: Vectors are more than just arrows.
animations: 1. Fade in a set of discrete physical objects [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/coins.svg] (colored #FFD700 circles).
2. Morph circles into abstract nodes (#00CED1 dots) connected by lines.
3. Highlight the abstraction path with a glowing arrow (#FFFFFF) leading to the final form [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/beads.svg].

sections.title: The Rulebook: The 8 Axioms
animations: 1. Display a stack of 8 abstract rule cards [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/card.png] (#4682B4).
2. Flash each card [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/card.png] individually as a defining principle.
3. Stack cards [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/card.png] into a single block with a central title.

sections.title: Example: The Polynomial Vector Space
animations: 1. Show a polynomial p(x) = ax^2 + bx + c (#FF4500) next to the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dna.svg].
2. Break coefficients into distinct basis component vectors (#32CD32).
3. Display these vectors spanning a 3D coordinate volume, reinforcing the structured genetic sequence of the [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dna.svg].

sections.title: Application: The Geometry of Data
animations: 1. Display a cloud of data points (#8A2BE2) using [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/emoji.svg].
2. Show a line of best fit emerging through the cloud (#FFFFFF).
3. Highlight the orthogonal projection lines from points to the fit.
